title: Cut Off Trees for Golf Event
problemStatement: You are given a forest represented as a grid. 0 represents an obstacle. 1 represents empty ground. Values greater than 1 represent trees with unique heights. Starting from the top-left cell, cut all trees in increasing order of height. Return the minimum total number of steps required to cut every tree, or -1 if any tree cannot be reached.
input: Integers m and n An m × n grid
output: A single integer representing the minimum number of steps.
